title: fix(update): update split-root Bun Gateway installs with their pinned runtime
body:
Related: #159431

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes `openclaw update` refusing an owned Bun Gateway at a different package root with `original-service-unverified`, and Bun package commands selecting bare `bun` from PATH instead of the verified executable.

## User Impact

Owned split-root Bun Gateway installations update in place with their recorded runtime pin; the invoking CLI installation stays unchanged. Package probes and installation retain the selected Bun even when PATH has no Bun or contains a different build.

Update behavior: the installed updater runs first. In the live Linux fixture, published 2026.9.6 with no Bun on PATH refused early with ENOENT, leaving the Gateway and both roots unchanged. With the fork Bun on PATH, that same published driver updated service root B in place and restarted healthy while CLI root A stayed unchanged. This PR's routing and verified-executable selection apply from the first candidate containing them; a newer candidate cannot retroactively change its installed driver's first hop.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing service-root update route and the shared Bun/SQLite executable validation, while preserving Node service routing and destination ownership checks. Bun's emulated Node version is not checked against `engines.node`. A Node-based updater still passes the target's Node engine and SQLite preflight because finalization retains the updater runtime. Bun package commands use the verified service Bun, then the current Bun process executable, with PATH only as the final fallback.

The two commits were rebased onto the prerequisite squash merge without conflicts. Initial production LOC: **+10 net**; the Doctor follow-up below adds **+6 net**. The three installation/update docs describe runtime selection and first-hop behavior; the changelog remains release-owned.

## Evidence

The original reviewed commits record five expected pre-fix failures for service routing/executable selection, plus two pre-fix failures for the old-Node and missing-SQLite-TEXT updater cases; those regressions passed after the fixes. Rebased-head validation and per-file single-worker wall times are recorded below.

Validated head: `c4421ba82d6c6e36c3ff2005aac0f59ffdd2a0f0`.

`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <file> --maxWorkers=1`: **5 Test Files / 92 tests passed**, measured separately with `/usr/bin/time -p` (**133.45 s total wall**).

| Test file | Tests passed | Wall time |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-plan.test.ts` | 47 | 50.70 s |
| `src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-root-plan.test.ts` | 7 | 12.49 s |
| `src/cli/update-cli/update-command-target.n1-prefix.test.ts` | 7 | 14.67 s |
| `src/infra/update-global.bun-owner.test.ts` | 6 | 19.65 s |
| `src/cli/daemon-cli/install.reinstall.test.ts` | 25 | 35.94 s |

Wall times include harness compilation, module transforms, and cleanup. These existing suites exercise runtime admission, update destination selection, package activation/cleanup, and daemon reinstall pin retention through their owning boundaries. CI timing is pending.

Also passed: `pnpm tsgo:core` (14.29 s wall), scoped oxlint and oxfmt on all 15 changed TypeScript files, oxfmt and MDX validation on all three changed docs, and `git diff --check`. Independent Codex autoreview against `origin/main` completed with no actionable P0–P2 findings.

Live proof ran on AWS Crabbox lease `cbx_761305c7e96a`, using the verified fork Bun build `6b9148b1` (`1.4.3-canary.1+6b9148b17`) and candidates built on the box. A is the invoking CLI installation; B is the managed Gateway installation. Initial S1/S2/S3 used `c4421ba82d6c6e36c3ff2005aac0f59ffdd2a0f0`; fresh S0′/S1b/S2b used the candidate built from `332b0938b61a7541a026d2c2996989a372006690`.

### Upgrade-compatibility proof (published driver × candidate)

The live cells below are the upgrade-compatibility proof requested by ClawSweeper: S0 uses published 2026.9.6 without Bun on PATH and refuses early with the Gateway and both roots unchanged; S0′ uses published 2026.9.6 with the fork Bun on PATH and updates B in place to a healthy candidate; S1/S2 exercise candidate Node/Bun drivers; S1b/S2b after `332b0938` verify maintenance leaves the updated Gateway running. This PR changes no schema, config format, or persisted data model. Runtime pins and service definitions keep their existing formats; no data migration is required.

| Live cell | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| S0: published 2026.9.6, no Bun on PATH | Early ENOENT refusal; Gateway PID and both package roots unchanged. This did not reach the topology guard. |
| S0′: published 2026.9.6, fork Bun on PATH | Update exited 0 (162.605 s); B advanced in place and restarted healthy on the fork; A stayed 2026.9.6. |
| S1: candidate Node CLI / S2: candidate Bun CLI | B advanced; A stayed unchanged; fork runtime pin retained. Observed Bun package writers used the absolute fork executable. |
| S3: stock Bun first on PATH | Update succeeded; the package writer still used the absolute pinned fork executable. |
| S1b / S2b before the Doctor fix | After aligning A with B, repair stopped the Gateway and left it stopped. A separate manual reinstall restored health; that is historical failure evidence, not successful repair proof. |
| S1b / S2b after `332b0938` | Update/align/repair/Doctor exits were 0/0/1/0. Through alignment, repair and Doctor, post-update PIDs 149594/145986 and fork pins stayed unchanged; all 76/51 liveness samples were active with HTTP 200, and final health passed. Repair exited 1 with actionable installation-drift guidance before any stop. |

Native lifecycle timestamps, restart counts and maintenance journals also showed no stop/restart during the fixed maintenance cells; approximately one-second samples do not claim continuous observation. No manual restart, reinstall or guard override was used for those reruns. The Linux fixture exercises the protected service-root path and explicit Bun writer, but does not independently isolate the owned-Bun routing predicate. System Node remained 24.18.1. Fixtures used synthetic credentials only; no credentials or raw private logs are included here. No configuration, stored schema or service-definition format changes are introduced; upgrade compatibility is covered by the published-driver and candidate-driver cells above.


## Live-proof follow-up: S1b/S2b Doctor admission

On `c4421ba82d6c6e36c3ff2005aac0f59ffdd2a0f0`, S1b (Node updater) and S2b (Bun updater) aligned the original invoking CLI A with the updated service installation B, then ran repair and Doctor from A. Repair returned exit 0/status warning but stopped the Bun Gateway at B and left it stopped because cross-installation reconciliation could not be verified. The separate manual reinstall from B restored health; it does not count as successful repair proof.

The fix excludes Bun runtimes at `resolveGatewayServiceInstallationRefreshRoot`, the shared admission owner for moving a service onto another CLI root. Doctor performs this inspection before the native stop. Explicit repair from A now refuses maintenance with installation-drift guidance while leaving the service and state untouched; run repair from B instead. Diagnostic service repair retains its drift note and skips installation. Node cross-root refresh admission is unchanged. No configuration, stored schema, or service-definition format changed.

Follow-up head: `332b0938b61a7541a026d2c2996989a372006690`.

Three regression cases failed before this fix: the real Doctor health flow admitted cross-root Bun maintenance with and without update context, and direct Doctor service repair invoked the installer. The corrected focused proof passed **4 Test Files / 56 tests**, all with `--maxWorkers=1`:

| Selection | Passed | Wall time |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `src/flows/doctor-health.test.ts` — Bun regressions and existing foreign-running controls | 4 tests; 70 unrelated cases skipped | 44.13 s |
| `src/commands/doctor-maintenance.installation.test.ts` — full suite, including Node cross-root behavior | 32 tests | 109.60 s |
| `src/daemon/service-layout.test.ts` and `src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-root-plan.test.ts` | 20 tests across 2 files | 37.29 s together |

The broader Doctor health migration matrix was interrupted to focus on these contracts; no full-file pass is claimed for that file. Wall times include harness preparation and cleanup. Core tsgo, Doctor and general source test-type graphs, scoped oxlint/oxfmt, both changed docs' MDX checks, `git diff --check`, and independent autoreview passed with no actionable P0–P2 findings. CI timing for this head is pending; no CI run was dispatched or rerun for proof.

Follow-up LOC versus `c4421ba`: production **+8/−2 (net +6)**; tests **+73/−1 (net +72)**; docs **+14/−0**. **Fresh live S1b/S2b replay against this exact fix is complete**, as recorded in the table above. Both Gateways remained healthy with unchanged PID and pin through maintenance. The requested all-zero maintenance outcome was not observed: repair intentionally returned 1 with drift guidance, leaving the service running. The original failed cells remain recorded separately.

Documentation follow-through: head `6745aaeb2eb9d20a6910f273aa6f5f87e27ebe95` corrects the same published-driver statement in `docs/install/bun-compatibility.md` and `docs/install/updating.md`. This is a docs-only delta from the live-tested `332b0938` production code. Both files passed oxfmt and MDX validation; `git diff --check` and independent Codex autoreview passed with no actionable P0–P2 findings. Current-head CI and ClawSweeper review remain landing gates.

Refresh validation: merged main `f010fc0b579071d151e8f4e4084a40ac0b219057` without conflicts into head `dbf35a674cffdbf8e6ce9b390df5d19b1f369f78`. The updater node-runtime/noop and service-plan/service-root-plan selections passed **4 Test Files / 65 tests**, using `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <files> --maxWorkers=1`, in **137.66 s wall**. Independent Codex autoreview found no actionable P0–P2 findings; `git diff --check` and the export-name collision guard passed. Package manifests and lockfile are unchanged versus main. Exact-head CI and ClawSweeper remain required landing gates.

Assertion follow-up: `b5f3bace55c231b5f6b2466151699150c77e8d35` updates the three planner output assertions to runtime-neutral wording, including the negative control. This fixes the stale expectation in CI run 36455674328 / job 109044885440. No production behavior changes in this follow-up.

Focused validation with `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <files> --maxWorkers=1`: **4 Test Files / 79 tests passed, 77.13 s total wall**. The complete `src/cli/update-cli.node-runtime.test.ts` passed 18 tests (48.01 s Vitest duration); the service-plan, service-root-plan, and target.n1-prefix files passed 47, 7, and 7 tests respectively (19.34 s combined Vitest duration). Total wall includes wrapper preparation and cleanup. Scoped oxfmt/oxlint, `git diff --check`, and independent Codex autoreview passed with no actionable P0–P2 findings. Repository search found no remaining old quotes of these planner messages; the separate Node-only schema diagnostic remains unchanged. Exact-head CI and ClawSweeper re-review are pending.

Hosted assertion-fix proof: on exact head `b5f3bace55c231b5f6b2466151699150c77e8d35`, CI run **36458778939**, the formerly failing `checks-node-changed-compact-large-7` job **109052394328** passed. Its Node test step took **545 s** (17:34:09–17:43:14 UTC); total job time was **587 s**. These are mixed-shard timings, not isolated-file timings. Aggregate CI and the fresh ClawSweeper verdict are still pending.
